answer: The original v1 schedule states Thursday at 09:30 local time. The later signed amendment v2 states that the project review was moved to Thursday at 10:00 local time and explicitly says it replaces the v1 time. Therefore, the meeting time supported as current by these records is Thursday at 10:00 local time; 09:30 is the superseded original schedule. The records do not identify the geographic time zone behind “local time.”

approaches.description: Read the two records in version order and apply the amendment’s express replacement statement to distinguish historical from current scheduling information.
approaches.reason: The amendment itself supplies both the new time and its relationship to v1.

claims.statement: The v1 record states Thursday at 09:30 local time.

citations.quote: This amendment replaces the time in v1.

claims.statement: The v2 amendment states Thursday at 10:00 local time and says that it replaces the time in v1.

claims.basis_reference: Derived by distinguishing the v1 time from the expressly replacing v2 time in step-current-time.
claims.statement: On these records, the current supported meeting time is Thursday at 10:00 local time; Thursday at 09:30 local time is the original, superseded time.

open_questions: The records use “local time” but do not specify a locality or time-zone identifier, so no conversion to another time zone is supported.

proof_steps.justification: This is the time stated in the v1 record.
proof_steps.statement: Record the original v1 meeting time as Thursday at 09:30 local time.

citations.quote: This amendment replaces the time in v1.

proof_steps.justification: The v2 record gives a new time and expressly characterizes it as replacing v1’s time.
proof_steps.statement: Record that v2 sets Thursday at 10:00 local time and replaces the v1 time.

proof_steps.justification: A time expressly designated as replacing the earlier v1 time is the current time supported by the two-record sequence, while the replaced time remains the original historical entry.
proof_steps.statement: Distinguish 09:30 as the original v1 time and 10:00 as the current v2-supported time.
